title: Open menu doesn't close when clicking outside it (e.g. on the stage)
description:
REPRO
1. Open a top menu (e.g. Modify) in the menu bar.
2. Click outside the dropdown on the STAGE work area.
3. EXPECTED: the dropdown closes (standard click-outside dismiss).
   ACTUAL: the menu stays open. (Clicking other CHROME outside the menu does close it.)

ROOT CAUSE
Dismiss mechanism: packages/authoring-ui/src/MenuBar.tsx:193-202 (MenuBarItem useEffect). It is option (b): a document-level listener, but registered ONLY for 'mousedown' --
  document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside)
handleClickOutside (line 195-199) calls onClose() when e.target is outside ref.current (the menu item div).

Why a stage click bypasses it (pointer-vs-mouse event mismatch, ties to task 1275):
The stage work-area now uses POINTER events. packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx:4394-4399 onPointerDown calls e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) before delegating to onMouseDown. Per the W3C Pointer Events spec, once an element captures the pointer, the browser SUPPRESSES the compatibility mouse events (mousedown/mouseup/click) for that pointer gesture -- they are not dispatched to document. So the MenuBar's document 'mousedown' listener never fires for a press that starts on the stage, and the open menu is never dismissed. (StageArea's own onMouseDown, line 1904, also calls preventDefault on many tool branches, which independently suppresses the compat mousedown even without capture.) Clicking on non-stage chrome (which still emits plain mousedown) DOES dismiss, confirming the event-type gap rather than an overlay/z-index issue. There is NO dismiss overlay -- the dropdown (styles.dropdown z-index 1001) sits inside the bar; dismissal relies entirely on the document mousedown listener.

REGRESSION VERDICT
Mixed: the document-mousedown dismiss listener is LONG-STANDING (present since the initial MenuBar commit 4b4e4cf, MenuBar.tsx:193-202, unchanged since). It became INEFFECTIVE FOR STAGE CLICKS as a regression introduced by the task-1275 stage pointer-events migration (StageArea.tsx:4394 onPointerDown + setPointerCapture). Before 1275 the stage emitted a plain mousedown that the listener caught; after 1275 pointer capture suppresses it.

FIX DIRECTION
Make the MenuBar dismiss robust to pointer-capturing children. Preferred: change the document listener to 'pointerdown' (and/or add it in addition to mousedown), since pointerdown fires on document BEFORE the stage element captures the pointer. Optionally attach it in the capture phase (addEventListener('pointerdown', fn, true)) so a child stopPropagation/capture cannot preempt it. Alternative: render a full-coverage transparent dismiss OVERLAY behind the dropdown that sits ABOVE the stage (z-index > stage stacking) and closes on its own pointerdown -- but the listener-swap is simpler and matches the existing approach.

FILES
- packages/authoring-ui/src/MenuBar.tsx:193-202 (dismiss listener)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx:4394-4399 (setPointerCapture on onPointerDown)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx:1904-1916 (onMouseDown preventDefault branches)

Priority: low (UX nit, user-reported).

---
RESOLUTION (agent-1304, 2026-06-19)
FIX: MenuBar.tsx MenuBarItem dismiss useEffect now registers the document listener
as pointerdown in the CAPTURE phase, replacing the bubbling mousedown listener:
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handleClickOutside, true)
pointerdown fires on document BEFORE the stage element captures the pointer
(StageArea onPointerDown setPointerCapture, confirmed StageArea.tsx:4394-4399), and
the capture phase runs even if a child stopPropagation's the bubbling event. The
handler still no-ops when e.target is inside ref.current, so dropdown item clicks,
keyboard nav, and switching between top-level menus are unaffected.

TEST: packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/menuBarOutsideClick.test.ts (NEW, 4 tests)
mounts the real <MenuBarItem> in jsdom and asserts: (1) a pointerdown OUTSIDE closes
the menu; (2) a pointerdown INSIDE (dropdown item) does NOT close; (3) a bare
mousedown outside is ignored (the event the stage suppresses), while a pointerdown
outside still dismisses. Verified the test FAILS (2/4) against the pre-fix mousedown
listener and PASSES (4/4) with the fix. MenuBarItem is now exported for the test.

VERIFICATION (commands + results):
  pnpm --filter './packages/**' build  -> Done (all 7 packages, green)
  cd packages/authoring-ui && vitest run -> Test Files 67 passed (67),
                                            Tests 901 passed (901). 0 failures
                                            (including the new test; no task-1207
                                            fixture failures).

FILES CHANGED:
- packages/authoring-ui/src/MenuBar.tsx (listener mousedown->pointerdown capture; export MenuBarItem)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/menuBarOutsideClick.test.ts (new regression test)
